_comment: Regauntless spells — transcribed VERBATIM from SRD 3.5 (OGL). SCOPE CAP: spell levels 0 (cantrips/orisons) and 1 ONLY, for the core casters Phase-1 would actually touch. PRIORITY: Sorcerer/Wizard 0-1 (arcane) + Cleric 0-1 (divine) are transcribed in full; Druid 0-1 and Bard 0-1 are TODO (see _todo). Spells are the CASTER LAYER — the 'regauntless' block is a DEFERRED first-pass mapping (how a spell would land in our real-time deterministic combat), NOT a final design. Many SRD spells are out-of-combat tabletop utility and are no-op for a horde crawl; that is recorded honestly. 'srd' block fields are verbatim-faithful stat-block entries; 'description' is a 1-3 sentence verbatim-faithful summary. Validate JSON after every edit. Pattern mirrors data/feats.json + data/skills.json (two-layer: srd + regauntless).

_schema.name: string
_schema.school: string — SRD school (+ descriptor/subschool in parens where relevant)
_schema.level: string — class lists + numeric level, verbatim, e.g. 'Sorcerer/Wizard 1, Cleric 1'

srd.range: string — verbatim (Personal | Touch | Close | Medium | Long | fixed ft.)
srd.description: string — 1-3 sentence verbatim-faithful summary of the effect

regauntless.status: clean | reinterpret | no-op | house — clean=maps as-is; reinterpret=same spirit, new mechanic; no-op=out-of-combat/tabletop, nothing to do for the crawl; house=keep flavor, redesign the mechanic
regauntless.delivery: flat | lob | cone | bolt | web | touch | self | buff | none — our ranged-delivery taxonomy (combat-model.md / combat-space.md). none=not a combat action
regauntless.note: SHORT — how (or whether) it maps to real-time deterministic combat

_todo: Druid level 0-1 list (d20srd.org/srd/spellLists/druidSpells.htm) — NOT transcribed this pass
Bard level 0-1 list (d20srd.org/srd/spellLists/bardSpells.htm) — NOT transcribed this pass
Spell levels 2-9 for ALL lists — explicitly out of scope (Phase-1 cap at 0-1)

Cross-list level-tagging: several spells here also appear on Druid/Bard/Paladin/Ranger lists; 'level' records only the lists confirmed from the Sor/Wiz + Cleric index pages this pass. Backfill other classes' levels when their lists are transcribed.
regauntless mapping is a DEFERRED first pass — revisit damage dice / save → to-hit translation against combat.md difficulty modes once the caster hero's shot economy is built.

srd.description: You fire a small orb of acid at the target as a ranged touch attack, dealing 1d3 points of acid damage.

regauntless.note: The archetypal weak arcane cantrip = a basic shot. Ranged-touch orb -> a 1d3 bolt down the lane; collision=hit (combat.md). The Wizard's default pea-shooter.

srd.description: A ray of freezing air and ice projects from your pointing finger; make a ranged touch attack to deal 1d3 points of cold damage.

regauntless.note: Same as Acid Splash as a basic shot (1d3 cold). Ray = a thin bolt lane; could carry a tiny slow flavor (cold) if we want elemental texture.

srd.description: You direct a ray of positive energy; make a ranged touch attack to deal 1d6 damage to one undead creature.

regauntless.note: A bolt that only bites undead (1d6 vs undead, nothing else). Maps to a conditional-damage shot vs the undead mob family — anti-undead flavor on the basic shot.

srd.description: Your touch (a melee touch attack) instills weariness, making the subject fatigued for the duration.

regauntless.note: Touch-range debuff. Fatigue (no run, Str/Dex penalty) -> a brief melee-range SLOW/weaken tag on one mob. Minor melee debuff for a gish caster.

srd.target: One humanoid creature of 4 HD or less
srd.description: This spell clouds the mind of a humanoid creature with 4 or fewer Hit Dice so that it takes no actions for 1 round.

regauntless.note: Single-target 1-round stun on a weak mob. Maps to a short freeze/stun applied to one low-HD target in LoS — crowd-control nibble, caps at trash mobs.

srd.description: This cantrip creates a burst of light; if aimed at a creature it dazzles it for 1 minute (-1 on attack rolls and Spot/Search).

regauntless.note: Dazzle = a flat to-hit/accuracy debuff on one target. Maps to a short accuracy-down tag (-1 band) on a mob's shot. Minor, situational against shooters.

srd.description: This spell causes a touched object to glow like a torch, shedding bright light in a 20-ft. radius.

regauntless.note: Illumination utility. Our view is top-down fixed-light; no fog-of-war to lift. No-op unless we ever add a darkness/vision mechanic.

srd.target: Up to four lights, all within a 10-ft.-radius area
srd.description: Creates up to four lights (torches, lanterns, or a faintly glowing vaguely humanoid shape) that you can move with concentration.

regauntless.note: Illumination/decoy utility. No fog-of-war to exploit; out-of-genre for the crawl.

srd.description: Ghost sound creates a volume of sound that rises, recedes, approaches, or remains in place as you wish.

regauntless.note: Audio-illusion social/exploration utility. Mobs sense via LoS, not sound bluffs; nothing to do for the crawl.

srd.target: One nonmagical, unattended object weighing up to 5 lb.
srd.description: You point your finger at an object and can lift it and move it at will from a distance (up to 5 lb., 15 ft./round).

regauntless.note: Light telekinesis utility. Possible far-future hook: pull a lever/key from afar in a puzzle room. No-op for combat.

srd.target: One object of up to 1 lb.
srd.description: Mending repairs small breaks or tears in objects (but not warps, burns, or missing pieces).

regauntless.note: Object-repair utility. No item-durability system; out-of-genre.

srd.description: You can whisper messages and receive whispered replies with chosen creatures at a distance, as if conversing quietly.

regauntless.note: Comms utility — party coordination is handled by the game's own UI/voice, not a spell. No-op.

srd.target: Object weighing up to 30 lb. or portal that can be opened or closed
srd.description: You can open or close (your choice) a door, chest, box, window, bag, pouch, bottle, barrel, or other container.

regauntless.note: Door/container utility. Possible puzzle hook (open a gate at range); no combat use.

srd.target: One personal rune or mark, all of which must fit within 1 sq. ft.
srd.description: This spell allows you to inscribe your personal rune or mark, visible or invisible, on any substance.

regauntless.note: Flavor/signature utility. No-op.

srd.description: Performs minor magical tricks: color/clean/soil objects, chill/warm/flavor 1 lb. of material, create small objects or illusions, etc.

regauntless.note: The grab-bag flavor cantrip. Pure whimsy/utility; no-op for the crawl (but on-brand for arcade flavor).

srd.description: You imbue the subject with magical energy that grants a +1 resistance bonus on saving throws.

regauntless.note: Flat +1 to saves. Maps to a short self/ally buff: +1 band to our resist-save checks (vs poison/stun/web). Tiny ward.

srd.description: You detect magical auras; the amount of information revealed increases with the number of rounds you study an area.

regauntless.note: Divination utility. No hidden-magic layer to probe; out-of-genre.

srd.target: One creature, one object, or a 5-ft. cube
srd.description: You determine whether a creature, object, or area has been poisoned or is poisonous.

regauntless.note: Divination utility. No-op.

srd.description: You can decipher magical inscriptions on objects — books, scrolls, weapons — that would otherwise be unintelligible.

regauntless.note: Scroll-prep utility (the gate on casting from scrolls at the table). In-game scroll use is an item-activation, not this spell; no-op.

srd.target: Up to five creatures, no two of which can be more than 15 ft. apart
srd.description: A missile of magical energy darts forth and strikes its target for 1d4+1 force damage, striking unerringly even in melee or through less-than-total cover. One extra missile per 2 caster levels (max 5).

regauntless.note: Signature arcane attack. 'Strikes unerringly' (no save, no to-hit) = a HOMING bolt: a shot that tracks to a target in LoS and can't miss. Multi-missile -> fires N tracking bolts split across targets. Premium Wizard shot.

srd.description: A cone of searing flame shoots from your fingertips, dealing 1d4 fire damage per caster level (max 5d4) to all in the area.

regauntless.note: Textbook CONE. Short 15-ft. fan of fire AoE in front of the caster; everyone caught takes the hit (Reflex-half -> our half-on-partial-clip rule). Core close-range crowd clearer.

srd.description: Your touch delivers 1d6 points of electricity damage per caster level (max 5d6); you gain +3 to hit if the target is wearing metal armor or carrying a metal weapon.

regauntless.note: Hard-hitting melee-range touch (1d6/level). Maps to a high-damage melee zap for a gish caster; the +3-vs-metal becomes a flat +band vs armored mobs.

srd.target: Creature or creatures touched (up to one/level)
srd.savingThrow: Fortitude partial or Will negates; see text
srd.description: A touch deals 1d6 negative energy damage and may deal 1 point of Strength damage (Fort negates); undead instead flee for 1d4+ rounds (Will negates). One touch per caster level.

regauntless.note: Multi-charge melee touch: holds N charges (one/level), each a 1d6 + Str-damage (weaken) tap. Str damage -> our offense-down debuff band. Undead-fear clause -> brief flee tag on undead mobs.

srd.description: A ray (ranged touch attack) saps strength, dealing 1d6+1 per two levels of Strength damage (target's Str cannot drop below 1).

regauntless.note: A debuff bolt: lands and applies a timed offense-down (Str loss -> reduced mob hit damage band, per combat-model.md Str->shot-damage axis). Softens a heavy hitter rather than killing it.

srd.description: You gain a +20 insight bonus on your next single attack roll, and are not affected by the miss chance from concealment.

regauntless.note: MIDS HOUSE-RULE: translate the INTENT, not the +20. SRD = +20 insight to your next attack roll within the round. In our model geometry IS the hit (no to-hit roll in Easy/Normal/Hard), so +20 is meaningless. Instead True Strike = FORCE A CRIT on your next attack/shot (your next hit is the guaranteed big swing). This is the FIRST 'forced/triggered deterministic crit' effect (see combat.md crit rule): crits aren't only a Gremlin-mode nat-20 thing — effects like this cause them even in deterministic modes. Self-buff, one-shot.

srd.target: One or more living creatures within a 10-ft.-radius burst
srd.description: Puts 4 HD of creatures (lowest HD first) into a magical slumber; sleepers are helpless. Affects only 4 HD or fewer; a standard action rouses a sleeper.

regauntless.note: Classic trash-clearer AoE. A lobbed 10-ft zone that disables up to 4 HD of weak mobs (helpless = free kills / skip). Caps at low-HD swarm — strong against generator spam, useless vs a boss. 1-round cast = a wind-up.

srd.description: A vivid cone of clashing colors stuns, blinds, and/or knocks unconscious weak creatures in the area based on their Hit Dice.

regauntless.note: A crowd-control CONE: short fan that stuns/blinds low-HD mobs in front of you (knockout scaling by HD). Defensive cone to buy breathing room in a swarm; weak vs high-HD.

srd.target: One living creature with 5 or fewer HD
srd.description: One creature of 5 HD or less becomes frightened and flees for 1d4 rounds (a successful save reduces this to shaken for 1 round). Creatures of 6+ HD are immune.

regauntless.note: Single-target flee on a weak mob: the target routs (runs from the party) for a few seconds. Maps to a short 'flee' AI override on one low-HD target. Soft CC.

srd.description: Summons one extraplanar creature from the 1st-level list, which appears where you designate and fights your opponents for the duration.

regauntless.note: Spawns a temporary friendly minion (a timed ally entity) that the AI drives against mobs. 1-round cast = wind-up. Mirrors the enemy 'generator' idea but player-side; a pet for the duration, then despawns.
